description.value:
You've achieved true unity between blaster and blade. Your Dexterity score and your Wisdom or Charisma score (your choice) each rise by 2, as do their maximums. You may also spend your action to gain the following, all lasting for 1 minute:

  • You resist kinetic, energy, and ion damage dealt by weapons.
  • Whenever you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you gain advantage on your next melee weapon attack against it; whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you gain advantage on your next ranged weapon attack against it.
  • Whenever a damage die rolls below half its maximum, you may treat it as though it rolled half its maximum instead, affecting up to a number of dice equal to half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum 1).

This benefit ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must complete a long rest before using it again.
